definitions.gloss: counter for volumes (of a book series); volume no. ~
definitions.explanation: Counts the volumes of a multi-volume work such as a manga series, encyclopedia, or novel, and with {第|だい} numbers them: {第三巻|だいさんかん} "volume three." Also counts reels of film and scrolls.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{五巻|ごかん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Five volumes of this manga are out so far.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二巻|にかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}くて→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧、⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧しまった。
examples.english: The second volume of the novel I borrowed from the library was so good I read it in one night.

notes:
COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {一巻|いっかん}, {二巻|にかん}, {三巻|さんかん}, {四巻|よんかん}, {五巻|ごかん}
- {六巻|ろっかん}, {八巻|はっかん}, {十巻|じゅっかん} (also じっかん)
- {何巻|なんかん}: how many volumes; which volume
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧〜{巻|かん}: complete in ~ volumes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧: counts physical books as objects; 〜{巻|かん} counts or numbers the volumes of one work. Three copies of volume one are {三冊|さんさつ}, not {三巻|さんかん}.
